title: Ghost Lows: an open benchmark for real-time CGM low-glucose alarms under sensor faults
description: An open benchmark that scores real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) low-glucose alarms on lows caught, false alarms per day and minutes of warning under a mixed sensor-fault suite (pressure-induced sensor attenuation, dropout, stale readings, drift, spikes), with a controlled ablation of what insulin and carbohydrate context adds. Research software; not a medical device.
notes: Co-authors with equal contribution: Pranav Reddy and Cohen Ferrari. Independent project by UCSB students; not funded or endorsed by UCSB. Benchmark results should also name the benchmark version they were computed on. Cite the datasets and simulator you use as listed in docs/reference/DATA.md and docs/CITATIONS.md.
